name: Trio
subtitle: 14K Gold Lab Diamond Stacking Ring
description:
Meet The Linked Trio, a contemporary take on the classic stacking ring.

Crafted in solid 14K yellow gold, this distinctive design brings together two polished gold bands and a centre band adorned with sparkling lab-grown diamonds. Each band measures a delicate 1.2 mm wide.

Two elongated oval gold links connect the bands, creating a beautifully layered look with subtle movement and dimension.

Designed to make a statement on its own, The Linked Trio gives you the appearance of a perfectly styled ring stack in one thoughtfully designed piece.

details.Total diamond weight: Approximately 0.11–0.24 CTW, depending on ring size
